question: Which packets and multiplicities belong to ordinary Hathor Skill/Burst casts?
stop_condition: Identify packets/multiplicities from saved descriptions and native arrays; use a disclosed bounded timing hypothesis if intervals are absent.
return_condition: New timing/reachability evidence changes Aerial Command 2x Skill1 + 1x Skill11 or Rider Express 2x UltraSkill1 + 1x UltraSkill2, Cyclone Strike, or Express Delivery Power stacks.
decision: Aerial Command describes 3 instances totaling 100%*2 + 100% at Lv1, matching native Skill1 (2 hits) and Skill11 (1 hit). Rider Express describes 3 instances totaling 96.2%*2 + 507.6% at Lv1, matching native UltraSkill1 (2 hits) and UltraSkill2 (1 hit). Require each action's primary packet; schedule children once after admission with the admitted effective native coordinate. Each hit settles independently; Emergency Delivery ATK bonus (+15%), A4 Cyclone Strike Crit Rate (+25%), and A6 Crit DMG (+30%) buffs trigger consistently.
timing_hypothesis: hathor.skill_burst_packets_v1: ordered coincident delivery on target zero at selected primary impact time. This supports packet totals and ownership, not native frame timing. Same-time delivery precedes queued gear callbacks; timing-sensitive results retain this assumption.
checks: Independent content damage oracles: at 1000 ATK/DEF.5/RES0, Skill levels 1/8/effective9 total 1725/1, 59133/20, 2937537/800 (with +15% Emergency Delivery ATK buff and A3 non-Boss dmg bonus); Burst levels 1/8/effective9 total 4025/1, 275931/40, 6854253/800.
Pending horizons, off-field ownership, dead/lethal targets, rejected energy admission and alternate primary are checked. Strict requires matching hypothesis acceptance.

Description and native arrays agree at all nine levels. Public two-Skill/one-Burst rotation produces 9 hits and spends 100 energy once; CLI/WASM/Worker agree. Full content, relevant character/gear web suites, replay and modeled awakening verifier pass.
No full kit/readiness claim. Normal chains, charge hold variants, Cyclone Strike forms, Express Delivery Power accumulation and full awakening mechanics remain pending.
